9 Records

9 A registered person must keep security records.

10 Security plan

(a) Keep a record of each transfer.

(b) Record each security assessment.

(c) Record each registration change.

(e) Keep incident records.

(f) Record each review.

(g) Record each disposal.

(h) Report a breach.

(i) Keep a disposition record.

(j) Provide a list on request.

11 Designated official

11 A designated official administers the program.

12 Assessment

12 A person is assessed before access.

13 Decision

13 The designated official decides access.

14 Notice

14 Give a written notice.

15 Review

15 Review access decisions.

16 Exemption

16 Record an exemption.

17 Temporary worker

17 Record a temporary worker exemption.

18 Student

18 Record a student exemption.

19 Visitor

19 Record a visitor exemption.

23 Expiry

23 An exemption expires as required.
